name: Grafenlehen
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Grafenlehen is located in Schönau am Königssee, near the border with Tirol. The four-star campsite is surrounded by mixed mountain forest. The Berchtesgadener Alpen with the Nationalpark Berchtesgaden shape the surroundings. In winter, the Jenner ski area serves as a destination. The amenities include pitches, sanitary building, bread roll service and a restaurant. A playground and a kiosk complete the offering. Hiking trails lead directly from the site into the Alps. The Königssee is within walking distance.
